modules.name: Snow reward
modules.note: Flurries - recommended for a first game.

steps.text: Board in the center, the Mountain along its top edge
Resources by their spots, Point tokens in piles, Fire tokens near the Hot Springs
Snow tokens on the peak of the Mountain
{n} Beacons on the Mountain as marked
steps.note: The two always-used Beacons, a third for 3-4 players, a fourth for 4

steps.text: Shuffle the Big Critters facedown left of the Mountain; 1 faceup on each of its {n} spots
Winter's Fury tile on the board, 1-Fire side up
Snowstorm deck: {n}, shuffle facedown on its spot
Reward tile on the Flurries side: 1 point per Snow cleared, +5 for the most
Reward tile on the Ice Storm side: 12 points for the most Snow cleared
Shuffle the Highland Quests; {n} faceup near the Guild, box the rest
steps.note: 1 per player + 1; Paws counts as a player

steps.text: Shuffle the Lowland Quests facedown near the Guild
Shuffle the main deck; {n} cards faceup in the Valley (stack duplicates, refill)
Deck facedown near the left of the board; discard pile forms on the right
Each player picks a Worker type: 2 workers, one with snowshoes as the Ranger; the other 4 in the seasons - 1 autumn, 1 winter, 2 spring
1 Chimney per player in the autumn and in the winter areas (none in your supply)
Each player takes {n} Fire token
Each player draws 2 Lowland Quests, keeps 1 secretly, puts the other at the bottom
Starting hands: 1st player 5 cards, 2nd 6, 3rd 7, 4th 8
steps.note: Each player may redraw their whole hand once during setup

steps.text: Choose a difficulty level; set up as for 2 players with Flurries; Paws gets workers and a Ranger (he prefers red)
Paws's Quest deck: 5 facedown Quests - level 1 all Lowland; level 2-3 swap 1 for a Highland; level 4 swap 2
Shuffle the Map and Scheme cards into two facedown stacks; reveal the top Map card; 10 Paws tokens nearby
You take your Lowland Quests as normal and draw 6 cards as the second player
Strict hand limit of 8 cards
Your Ranger may visit an occupied Location, or gains a Fire when visiting one alone
The coldest player goes first
steps.note: Solo: Paws goes first and has no hand
